description: The Length of The New Roads Added in The Emirate is a dataset listed in Ajmandata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Municipality & Planning Department. Total length of the new roads added in the emirate (Kilometer). Coverage: Ajman emirate. The portal files it under Transport and infrastructure. The portal shows 12 records. The portal shows 2025-11-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ajman-ae-portal.
